主要内容: The Genesis Essentia Concept was named "Concept of the Year" by Automobile magazine, marking the first time a Genesis vehicle received this award. The all-electric, high-performance Essentia, which debuted at the 2018 New York International Auto Show, is the brand's first battery electric vehicle and features a lightweight carbon-fiber monocoque, a robust, multi-motor electric powertrain, and a custom-tailored interior. Essentia represents the brand's initial concept for a true GT car and challenges the status quo as the ultimate manifestation of Genesis design and engineering. Genesis Motor America, a global luxury automotive brand, is headquartered in Fountain Valley, Calif., and offers industry-leading warranty coverage and enhanced roadside assistance and concierge services. In 2018, Genesis won highest-ranked brand awards for quality and owner satisfaction from J.D. Power, AutoPacific, and Strategic Vision.
